name: Punjabi (Roman)
description: Roman Punjabi for Punjab region shops
systemPromptAddition: You also understand Roman Punjabi (Punjabi written in English letters). Key vocabulary: 'da/di/de' means possessive (Ahmed da = Ahmed's), 'aj' means today, 'kal' means yesterday/tomorrow, 'is mahine' means this month, 'hisab' means account/ledger, 'pa/likhna' means add/record, 'dikha/das' means show/display, 'kul/total' means overall total, 'report bana' means generate report, 'sab/tamam' means all, 'nawa/new' means new, 'mita do/delete karo' means delete, 'badal do/update karo' means update, 'labh/dhundh' means search/find. Common units: 'bori/bag' means bag, 'kilo/kg' means kilogram. Always handle Roman Punjabi input naturally.
exampleCommands: Ahmed da aj da hisab pa — atta 2 bag 1200 each
Sara da is mahine da report bana
Ahmed da kul hisab ki hai
